establishmentName.title: Establishment / Company Name
establishmentName.description: Company or establishment name to search in OSHA inspection records (e.g. 'Amazon', 'Tesla', 'Acme Construction').

state.title: US State Code (2 letters)
state.description: Optional two-letter US state abbreviation (e.g. TX, CA, NY, OH).

naicsCode.title: NAICS Industry Code
naicsCode.description: Optional 2- to 6-digit NAICS industry code filter (e.g. '236220' or '493110').

openDateFrom.title: Inspection Open Date From (YYYY-MM-DD)
openDateFrom.description: Optional earliest inspection open date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

openDateTo.title: Inspection Open Date To (YYYY-MM-DD)
openDateTo.description: Optional latest inspection open date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

includeViolations.title: Include Violations & Penalties
includeViolations.description: Fetch linked OSHA citations/violations and penalty amounts for each inspection by activity_nr.

maxRecords.title: Maximum Inspection Records
maxRecords.description: Maximum number of inspections to retrieve across paginated DOL API calls.

outputMode.title: Output Mode
outputMode.description: Choose 'detailed' for full inspection rows or 'mcp_summary' for a token-efficient aggregate JSON summary ideal for AI agents.

dolApiKey.title: DOL API Key (Optional Override)
dolApiKey.description: Optional US Department of Labor Open Data API Key. Leave blank to use the Actor's configured DOL_API_KEY.
